description:
## Objective and agreed scope
Land Channels PR 2 first: deliver explicitly supplied Outgoing.attachments Records through existing Jido/Mattermost/Telegram and email paths. Reuse Materialization and provider clients; preserve routing, trusted authorization, final provider IDs, safe confirmation and resource ownership.

Seven production files targeted: engine/messages/outgoing.ex; channels/api.ex; new channels/delivery_files.ex; channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex; channels/email_bridge.ex; channels/email_bridge/smtp_sender.ex; existing channels/delivery_confirmation.ex. DeliveryFiles is the only new production module. Target fewer than 1,500 changed production lines; account tests/docs separately. Review scope before exceeding it.

## Settled decisions
- Adapter/provider owns attachment count and upload size restrictions. No ZAQ limits catalog, one-file policy, silent omission, sequential-send loop or protocol extension.
- Status translates actual adapter results safely: success; reported actionable rejection; generic fallback for unclear errors; uncertainty after ambiguous timeout. Do not invent thresholds. Insufficient adapter errors are fixed upstream.
- No user cancellation feature. Process/node/transport interruption may leave acceptance uncertain. Release prepared references and owned temporary resources; never delete original datasource files.
- Audit existing retries/duplicate suppression and preserve behavior. No new automatic retry, deduplication store or exactly-once claim. Bookkeeping/status failures must not trigger another send.
- Existing materialization buffers whole content. Acquisition budgets are separate GitHub #875, not a prerequisite or implementation task in this PR. Do not claim a post-read size check bounds acquisition memory.
- Keep both real-provider E2E modules in Channels, entering through an authorized Outgoing Event. Agent PR later extends the same modules with two-turn user/Agent journeys, retaining Channels regression scenarios.
- Agent tool selection, StreamEvents/Executor/Pipeline propagation, generated artifacts and Web Bridge work are excluded.

## References and prior work
GitHub #276 shared/chat delivery; #652 email. #875 https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/875 is separate resource work.
Reuse evidence from zaq-ic9 (inbound media), zaq-o9d (existing provider test infrastructure; simulated provider tests do not substitute for real-server receipt), and zaq-9th (DeliveryConfirmation rescue/exit tests, already reported implemented). Do not duplicate or close their unrelated scope.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend Outgoing builder, Channels API/bridges, SMTP composition and confirmation projection. Reuse Materialization signed handles/registered source handlers/fixed role Events, Jido Thread.post/FileUpload and Swoosh/Mailer. DeliveryFiles is a local-only preparation/cleanup helper with no independent tool/workflow operation; expose no new Action. Trusted actor comes from Event, never file metadata; nil is not elevated access. Confirm the live moduledocs and contracts before coding each child.

## Delivery and validation
User authorized planning/epic creation only in this turn. No implementation, GitHub modification or git commit/push is implied. Preserve existing test assertions. E2E scenarios and status semantics are already approved planning scope; repository final feature review is tracked separately before new E2E authoring. Do not request approval again for settled design choices. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md and docs/testing-approach.md. Post-review coverage handoff and final validation remain required before final human approval.

Channels plan: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_0d26b92b5bc8819181fab088efc0283c
Agent follow-up: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_bdc818e595dc8191ac1712b564afda86

## Execution sequence
Linear sequence intentionally keeps the single small PR reviewable and avoids diamonds. Related suites can be reused without making unrelated epics hard prerequisites.

```mermaid
graph LR
  S1["zaq-juu.1"] --> S2["zaq-juu.2"]
  S2["zaq-juu.2"] --> S3["zaq-juu.3"]
  S3["zaq-juu.3"] --> S4["zaq-juu.4"]
  S4["zaq-juu.4"] --> S5["zaq-juu.5"]
  S5["zaq-juu.5"] --> S6["zaq-juu.6"]
  S6["zaq-juu.6"] --> S7["zaq-juu.7"]
  S7["zaq-juu.7"] --> S8["zaq-juu.8"]
```

1. zaq-juu.1 — Add Outgoing attachment contract
2. zaq-juu.2 — Prepare files through existing materialization and trusted context
3. zaq-juu.3 — Wire Jido uploads and provider outcome status
4. zaq-juu.4 — Wire email attachment composition
5. zaq-juu.5 — Preserve confirmation safety and delivery lifecycle
6. zaq-juu.6 — Record final feature presentation review for E2E
7. zaq-juu.7 — Implement both real-provider delivery E2Es and async isolation
8. zaq-juu.8 — Complete docs review coverage handoff and final validation

comments.text: Verified all eight child tasks and reciprocal blocked_by/blocks edges: linear acyclic sequence .1 -> .2 -> .3 -> .4 -> .5 -> .6 -> .7 -> .8, no diamonds. Only .1 is an unblocked implementation child; bw ready displays the open parent epic rather than its child. Start with zaq-juu.1 when implementation is authorized. Channels plan and main-page summary updated with settled provider-limit/status/interruption decisions. Related zaq-9th coverage already reports implementation; reuse rather than duplicate. No application code or tests changed; working tree clean.

Implementation authorized by user on 2026-10-27: work on feat/channel-files, per-issue checks/review then Conventional Commit and push to origin/feat/channel-files, confirm push before close and bw sync. Supersedes planning-only authorization in original description. Verified live linear dependency graph .1 through .8, only .1 unblocked. Context Mode execution and Serena Elixir navigation verified; automatic Codex hooks absent, native tools available.
